description: Where a company's revenue comes from, read from the XBRL of its latest 10-K (or 10-Q): revenue and operating income by business segment, revenue by product or service and by region, for up to three years, with the company's own labels and each breakdown checked against total revenue.

form.description: Annual (10-K, default: fiscal years) or quarterly (10-Q: the quarter).

name: segment_revenue

outputSchema.description: each breakdown has rows of members with revenue (and operating income) per period in the order of columns, and latest_sum_vs_total, the members' sum over total revenue.

title: Revenue by segment
